text:
Tess CSM: FYI — noticed a cluster of mid-market customers showing low feature depth (using only basic endpoints). want to trial a "value-mapping" micro-experiment before pursuing downgrades. quick poll: who can help run 5 pilot accounts this week? :mag:

Marco AM: I'm in for two accounts. what's the experiment?

Tess CSM: five-step micro-experiment to surface missed value + low-friction remediation:
1) map top 3 product flows they should use (day 0)
2) 15m call to show one quick win (day 2)
3) attach a prebuilt snippet or template tailored to their stack (day 3)
4) short-term tweak: temporarily bump quota on the specific endpoint linked to the quick win (48h)
5) follow-up NPS-style pulse (one Q) and capture "what stopped you" (day 7)

Ivy Enablement: I can do the 15m calls for 3 of them and create the template snippets.

Sam Ops: can we automate the 48h quota bump so CS doesn't have to touch billing? FlowBot can do that with a guard condition.

FlowBot: automation rule drafted:
```
trigger: pilot_value_mapping
conditions:
  - account_tier == midmarket
  - usage_depth < 2
actions:
  - notify: CSM + AM + Enablement
  - schedule_call: day2
  - grant_temp_quota: endpoint_X: +30% duration:48h
  - add_survey: day7 question:"What blocked you from using feature X?"
```
Test queued in staging.

Marco AM: messaging suggestion: in outreach lead with ROI example "add this snippet and reduce dev time by 20%". shorter wins convert better.

Tess CSM: love that. Marco, can you craft two subject lines and one short script for Ivy's calls?

Ivy Enablement: will do. also will log each template into the enablement library and tag by language (python/node/ruby).

Tess CSM: tracker update plan: add columns for "experiment_id", "snippet_used", "temp_quota_granted", "pulse_response". Nora from PM asked to get anonymized signals monthly.

Sam Ops: heads-up: add billing guard — don't grant temp quota if invoices > 30 days. FlowBot will enforce.

Tess CSM: perfect. action items:
- Tess: pick 5 pilot accounts + kickoff message (today)
- Marco: draft outreach subject lines + script (4h)
- Ivy: run 15m calls for 3 accounts + upload templates (48h)
- Sam/FlowBot: enable automation + billing guard + run staging dry-run (24h)
- PM: get anonymized aggregate report on pilot signals (monthly)

Marco AM: quick note — if one account re-engages strongly, let's convert to the full staircase or staggered saveflow. don't want to lose momentum.

Tess CSM: agreed. we'll escalate any wins. thanks team! :sparkles:
